title: Alignment Services & Plans Line Card — Prices, Terms and Eligible Vehicles
content:
Alignment Services & Plans are sold one holding per vehicle in six lines. The line card below sets, for every line, the price, what the term is measured in, how long it runs, what the holding entitles the vehicle to, and which vehicles it may be sold for.

## Price, term and entitlement

| Line | Price (USD, before any tire bundle discount and tax) | Term measured in | Term | Entitlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | 89.99 | calendar months | 6 months from the purchase date (the period of the readjustment guarantee) | a single service: one alignment plus guarantee readjustments |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | 109.99 | calendar months | 6 months from the purchase date (the period of the readjustment guarantee) | a single service: one alignment plus guarantee readjustments |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | 169.99 | calendar months | 12 months from the purchase date | unlimited alignments within the interval |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 219.99 | calendar months | 36 months from the purchase date | unlimited alignments within the interval |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 249.99 | vehicle ownership (lifetime: as long as the purchaser owns the vehicle) | not applicable | unlimited alignments within the interval |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 299.99 | vehicle ownership (lifetime: as long as the purchaser owns the vehicle) | not applicable | unlimited alignments within the interval |

## Alignment types and the purchase-visit alignment

| Line | Alignment types the holding includes | First alignment performed on the purchase visit |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | two-wheel, thrust | Yes |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | two-wheel, thrust, four-wheel | Yes |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | two-wheel, thrust, four-wheel | Yes |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | two-wheel, thrust, four-wheel | Yes |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | two-wheel, thrust, four-wheel | Yes |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | two-wheel, thrust, four-wheel | Yes |

## Eligible vehicles and use

| Line | Vehicle classes the line may be sold for | Further entry terms | May be sold for or used on a vehicle in commercial use | Fleet account's alignment discount applies when charged to a fleet account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | passenger car, SUV or crossover, minivan | front axle adjustable only | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | passenger car, SUV or crossover, minivan, light truck, commercial van | front and rear axles adjustable | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | passenger car, SUV or crossover, minivan, light truck | personal use | No | No |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | passenger car, SUV or crossover, minivan, light truck | personal use | No | No |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | passenger car, SUV or crossover, minivan | personal use | No | No |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | light truck, SUV or crossover, passenger car | personal use; includes lifted trucks and performance cars with aftermarket suspension | No | No |

## Reading the card

- A term "measured in calendar months" runs the number of months shown from the purchase date; a lifetime line has no month term and runs as long as the purchaser owns the vehicle.
- On the two single-service lines the 6-month term is the period of the readjustment guarantee that comes with the one alignment.
- Example (hypothetical): a plan line whose card shows "No" in the commercial-use column is not sold for a vehicle in commercial use, and a fleet account's alignment discount does not apply to it; a line showing "Yes" in both columns may be sold for such a vehicle and charged to a fleet account with that discount.
